title: LightGBM Momentum Crash Filter on 30-Stock Universe

source.paper: Momentum Crashes Are Optional (If You Let ML Filter Them)
source.academic_basis: Daniel & Moskowitz (2016) momentum crash risk; LightGBM feature importance for regime detection

hypothesis: A LightGBM model trained on macro + technical features can identify high-crash-risk momentum periods and gate the H198 6-1m momentum signal. EdgeTools blog claims MaxDD reduction from 30% to 13% on a 2-class crash/no-crash classifier. On our 30-stock universe (H198 OOS Sharpe 1.174), a crash filter should preserve upside while reducing the 2022 drawdown.
features: Momentum portfolio trailing 6m return (winner minus loser decile spread)
Market cap dispersion (cross-sectional vol of log market cap)

variants.D: H198 + LightGBM crash probability continuous scaling (multiply position by 1-P_crash)

design.gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.174 (H198 baseline) AND MaxDD improvement > 5pp

implementation_notes: Target variable: 1 if H198 monthly return < -5% (momentum crash), 0 otherwise
Requires out-of-sample prediction only (no train/test contamination) — use 2yr rolling train window
Expected n_crashes in IS: ~8-12 months with < -5% return
